title: Technology Sector Update for 11/20/2018: PSTG, INTU
text:

Technology stocks were declining again in recent trading, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing 1.9% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was slipping 0.2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Pure Storage ( PSTG ) rose 3% on Tuesday after the data storage company reported better-than-expected fiscal Q3 results, including non-GAAP net income of $0.13 per share, improving on a $0.04 per share adjusted profit during the year-ago period and topping the Capital IQ consensus by $0.04 per share. Revenue climbed 34% year-over-year to $372.8 million, also exceeding the $367.4 million analyst mean.
In other sector news:
(-) Intuit's ( INTU ) was down 2.5% on Tuesday despite the software company reporting non-GAAP Q1 earnings of $0.29 per share, climbing from $0.17 per share during the year-earlier quarter and more than doubling the Capital IQ consensus expecting $0.11 per share. Revenue rose to $1.02 billion from $910 million a year ago, also exceeding the $971.45 million estimate.
